codes.description: Acute on chronic diastolic (congestive) heart failure
Hypertensive heart disease with heart failure
Long term (current) use of oral hypoglycemic drugs
Dependence on other enabling machines and devices

reason: Lab-documented hyponatremia (Na 127-129, low serum osm, treated with fluid restriction and daily BMP monitoring) is never diagnosed by a provider, so E871 cannot be coded without a query. Also, I110 (hypertensive heart disease with HF) is only assumed by the ICD-10-CM presumed-relationship convention, but hypertension is not documented anywhere in the chart, so I110 should NOT be assigned; the I110 code in my list is an error and should be removed on review. Z9989 for CPAP dependence is optional. Z7984 is appropriate for metformin only if long-term oral hypoglycemic use is documented (it is in the med list). Pleural effusions are integral to HF and not coded. Recommend a physician query for hyponatremia and coder verification of the hypertension and Z-code entries.
